# SocialReins

> Open-source social media manager for Facebook, Instagram, Threads, LinkedIn, Bluesky, X, TikTok and YouTube. Self-host it free today; the cloud is not open yet.

- [Home](https://socialreins.com/): what SocialReins does and the waitlist
- [Contact](https://socialreins.com/contact): send the team a message
- [Privacy Policy](https://socialreins.com/privacy)
- [Terms of Service](https://socialreins.com/terms)
- [Data Deletion](https://socialreins.com/data-deletion)
- [What you can post where](https://socialreins.com/post-types): post types each network supports
- [What you can post to Bluesky](https://socialreins.com/bluesky): post types and limits on Bluesky
- [What you can post to Threads](https://socialreins.com/threads): post types and limits on Threads
- [What you can post to LinkedIn](https://socialreins.com/linkedin): post types and limits on LinkedIn
- [What you can post to Facebook](https://socialreins.com/facebook): post types and limits on Facebook
- [What you can post to Instagram](https://socialreins.com/instagram): post types and limits on Instagram
- [What you can post to YouTube](https://socialreins.com/youtube): post types and limits on YouTube
- [What you can post to X](https://socialreins.com/x): post types and limits on X
- [What you can post to TikTok](https://socialreins.com/tiktok): post types and limits on TikTok
- [Pricing](https://socialreins.com/pricing): self-hosting is free; the cloud version is not open yet and has no price set
- [Docs](https://socialreins.com/docs): guides for the self-hosted and cloud versions
- [Install SocialReins on your own server](https://socialreins.com/docs/self-hosted): Docker Compose install, domains, platform apps, updates
- [Connect accounts and publish, self-hosted](https://socialreins.com/docs/self-hosted/use)
- [Connect an AI assistant to your own SocialReins](https://socialreins.com/docs/self-hosted/ai): MCP server and API tokens
- [Get started with SocialReins Cloud](https://socialreins.com/docs/cloud): not open yet, waitlist
- [Connect accounts and publish on SocialReins Cloud](https://socialreins.com/docs/cloud/use)
- [Connect an AI assistant to SocialReins Cloud](https://socialreins.com/docs/cloud/ai): MCP server and API tokens
- [Compare SocialReins](https://socialreins.com/compare): SocialReins next to other tools
- [SocialReins vs PostSyncer](https://socialreins.com/compare/postsyncer)
- [SocialReins vs Manychat](https://socialreins.com/compare/manychat)
- [SocialReins vs Buffer](https://socialreins.com/compare/buffer)
- [SocialReins vs Hootsuite](https://socialreins.com/compare/hootsuite)
- [SocialReins vs Later](https://socialreins.com/compare/later)
- [SocialReins vs Postiz](https://socialreins.com/compare/postiz)
- [Source code](https://github.com/socialreins/socialreins)
